WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot) AS max_snapshot
    FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala
),
non_saudi_pop AS (
    SELECT nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT id, dependent_seq_no) AS individual_count
    FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala, latest_snapshot
    WHERE is_in_population = TRUE
      AND snapshot = max_snapshot
      AND TRIM(nationality) != 'العربية السعودية'
    GROUP BY nationality
),
ranked_nationalities AS (
    SELECT nationality, individual_count,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY individual_count DESC) AS rank_desc,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY individual_count ASC) AS rank_asc
    FROM non_saudi_pop
)
SELECT nationality AS الجنسية, individual_count AS عدد_الأفراد
FROM ranked_nationalities
WHERE rank_desc <= 5 OR rank_asc <= 5
ORDER BY individual_count DESC LIMIT 1200
